title.narrative: Access to Climate Finance in the Pacific

description.narrative: The project aims to support eight PICs in enhancing access to climate finance from a blend of public and private sources by employing and strategically embedding climate finance advisors within the government ministries. These advisors work closely with government counterparts and stakeholders to design, consult, develop, and submit concept notes and full proposals. The Project also includes feasibility studies to progress investment pipeline projects, and capacity-building for civil servants, knowledge-sharing dialogues, and inclusive, gender-responsive engagement with donors and development partners. Its goal is to create a pipeline of high-quality investment projects approved and funded by various investors.

The project is a second Phase of PAC08 - Climate Finance Access Network - but witha focus on the Pacific only and no global activities. The project will work in 8 Pacific Islands Countries to continue to 1) develop a pipeline of adaptation/mitigation projects, aligned with national priorities, through in-country stakeholder engagement 2) draft concept notes and full proposals and submit them to funding agencies/investors, including working with regional and national direct access entities and 4) build long-term capacity through in-country trainings.
